storyline.real: Piastri leads from the first corner, but Norris gets ahead with the earlier second stop. McLaren tell Norris to give the place back; he does on lap 68, and Piastri takes his first win by 2.1 s, McLaren's first one-two since Italy 2021.

mastery.label: McLaren one-two on two more stops, as Piastri made

hidden.label: McLaren one-two without a single push lap

eras.briefing: Hungaroring, 2024. Norris and Piastri lock out the front row, McLaren's first since Brazil 2012, and Piastri takes the lead from Norris at the start. You run Piastri, 3.4 s ahead of Norris after 14 laps. Bring the McLarens home one-two.
